caseName: Kirk v. Sheriff of Los Angeles County
caseNameFull: Kirk v. Sheriff of Los Angeles County
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Stanley Mosk, Attorney General of California, and William E. James, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
